component.name: Orcinus
component.summary: A file manager based on KDE Dolphin

description.p: Orcinus is a customizable file manager based on KDE Dolphin. It preserves Dolphin's authorship, licensing, and integration with KDE Frameworks while developing an independent product identity and additional features.
Orcinus is an unofficial fork. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by KDE e.V. or the Dolphin developers.
